reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and extends the existing weekend helper, but implements daily skip policy separately in getNextDate and both server handlers.

duplication.why: Daily eligibility, excluded-day filtering, and skip-versus-move dispatch are repeated across the shared utility and the two handlers.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but the server handlers also own scheduling policy that should reside alongside it.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested schedule rules, range handler, configuration propagation, and related tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several implementations of the same occurrence policy, separate lookahead calculations, and budget paths that bypass daily filtering.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts calls getNextDate with noSkipWeekend=true and then applies getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly at two sites, bypassing the daily skip policy in getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The imperative daily filtering and adjustment dispatch in shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate are reshaped into filter/map pipelines in app.ts:getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate adds daily-specific forward filtering, reverse filtering, and adjustment exclusion; both app.ts handlers independently implement the policy, while two schedule-template.ts adjustment sites bypass it.
